acceptanceResults: Measure status warm startup and medium observation using the release/installed Runtime boundary on the declared local platform; record samples, median, filesRead/filesHashed, gitCalls, elapsedMs, Runtime identity, and repository identity. The gate must fail closed when a declared budget is exceeded or evidence is missing.

For a clean repository snapshot, avoid invoking an equivalent Git diff subprocess when no changed paths exist; preserve exact changed-path, diff-digest, source-tree-digest, snapshot identity, and fail-closed semantics. Dirty, unknown, or changed inputs must retain the full diff path.

Enforce the documented status <50 ms and medium observation <100 ms targets in a real identity-bound performance gate, or emit a bounded failed assessment with the measured gap; never weaken governance or silently widen the budget.

Keep all optimization request-scoped and repository-local: no process-global current repository, cross-repository cache, shared evidence, or object-project-specific code. Adopter guidance must use the shared external Runtime with explicit --repo and preserve per-repository evidence identity.

Performance regression, repository isolation, lifecycle, tri-language documentation, and full workspace quality tests pass; the performance gate covers both positive and negative budget cases and remains independent from governance authorization.
